name: From-Scratch Dim Sum
description: Cooking Class Description: As friends gather to sample and share delectable bite-size morsels; it’s easy to see why dim sum translates to \"touch the heart.\" In this fun; hands-on class; you’ll work alongside classmates practicing the steps for making perfect dumplings—from forming and folding to pleating and steaming. Our chef instructor will show you how to make dough for wrappers and prepare delicious fillings for a variety of savory treats. After mastering a few simple techniques; you’ll look forward to impressing guests at your own dim sum party.What To Expect: In our classes you'll work together with other students (in groups of 4); sharing workstations and equipment in a fun; hands-on environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 2 hours; unless otherwise noted above.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing; cooking; and working for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back.Students receive a coupon for 10% off in-store purchases the day of class.Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class.Prices vary by location.Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.

name: Tiny Taste Makers: Pinwheel Party
description: Cooking Class Description: In a world of rushing; multitasking and screens; this class is a small; joyful reset. You’ll start with Perfect Pizza Dough and a Hidden Veggie Pizza Sauce that’s as kid-friendly as it is parent-approved. Then you’ll roll up savory Veggie Pizza Pinwheels and finish with sweet Cinnamon Sugar Pinwheels for a cozy; cinnamon-kissed finale.This community-centered experience is designed for hands-on toddler fun in a relaxed; welcoming space for adults to chat and meet other caregivers. In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

Limited to just four guests; you'll enjoy personalized instruction from our in-house coffee specialist as you learn how to brew café-quality coffee using French Press and Pour Over methods.This in-store experience covers everything from selecting the right equipment and grind size to perfecting brew ratios and techniques. Whether you’re new to brewing or looking to elevate your morning ritual; you’ll leave with the skills and confidence to craft a balanced; flavorful cup—one you'll be proud to make at home.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.

In a small group of just four guests; you’ll get personalized coaching from a Sur La Table chef as you learn to chop; slice; dice; and mince like a pro.Discover how to handle your knife with precision and ease; practice essential techniques; and pick up pro tips that make prep work faster; safer; and more enjoyable. Whether you're sharpening your basics or starting fresh; this focused class will elevate your everyday cooking.Bonus: Knife Sharpening available for $8 per knife. Bring your favorite knife - because every great cook deserves a razor-sharp edge.What To Expect: In these specialty classes; you’ll enjoy an intimate; hands-on experience with a maximum of four guests per session. Classes take place on the retail floor in dedicated specialty areas; creating a unique and interactive environment led by our professional chef instructors.Classes are 1 hour.Hands-on classes are limited to 14-16 students; depending on location.You will be standing and actively engaged for most of the class.Please wear comfortable; closed-toe shoes and have long hair tied back. Cancellations or changes must be completed at least 48 hours before the start time of class. Sur La Table recipes are developed using common cooking and baking ingredients that may or may not be specified in the menu titles; including various fruits and vegetables; nuts; meats; spices; wheat flours; etc. If you have a food allergy; please check with your local Cooking School before attending the class. Adjustments to recipes cannot be made during class.Note: Food is not served during these specialty classes.
